summary: The recall of Enalapril 10 mg Arya batches GQQ24053, GQQ24064, GQQ24066, GQQ24067 has been reported by SAHPRA and subsequently echoed by the African Medicines Agency (AMA) as a repost of the SAHPRA alert. No other national regulators, WHO, or credible news outlets have issued separate alerts for these specific batches.

findings.evidence_quote: The South African Health Products Regulatory Authority (SAHPRA) has initiated the recall of four batches of Enalapril 10mg Arya, a medicine commonly used to treat high blood pressure (hypertension), following the identification of out-of-specification results during post-marketing surveillance inspections.
